about.name: Praveen Prasad
about.title: Full Stack Developer
about.bio: I’m a full stack developer based in Malappuram, Kerala. I build websites, web applications, and workflow automations with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and n8n, from the interface people use to the APIs and integrations behind it. I started out at Chimera in Trivandrum building responsive websites and application features, and today I build web applications at Beegains Technology Solutions. My approach is hands-on: understand the problem, get a working version in front of people, then refine the details.

experiences.title: Senior Frontend Developer
experiences.description: I build web applications with Next.js and TypeScript, contribute full stack features across the frontend and backend, and connect business workflows with n8n. When the work calls for a new tool, I learn it and apply it to the product need in front of me.

experiences.title: Web Developer
experiences.description: I developed responsive websites and application features with React, Node.js, MongoDB, and WordPress, working across frontend and backend implementation to turn project requirements into usable web experiences.

services.title: Web applications
services.description: Custom web applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Node.js, from the screens your users work in to the APIs and data behind them. The code is organised so new features can be added without starting over.

services.title: Interfaces & interaction
services.description: Responsive, accessible interfaces that turn a design into something clear and consistent to use on any screen, with motion only where it helps people understand what is happening.

services.title: Content-driven websites
services.description: WordPress websites, custom themes, and plugins that let your team publish and update content themselves, without waiting on a developer for every change.

services.title: Connected workflows
services.description: n8n automations that move information between your APIs, CRMs, and internal tools, so the repetitive steps between systems run on their own instead of by hand.

services.title: Online storefronts
services.description: Shopify storefronts and shopping flows that make your products easy to browse and buy, built so your team can manage the store day to day.

services.title: Technical collaboration
services.description: A second pair of eyes on architecture, code, and implementation decisions, plus hands-on help for teams working toward a release.

projects.title: Product Share
projects.description: A SaaS platform for small businesses and entrepreneurs who need a simple way to show customers what they sell. Sellers build a product catalogue and share it through one link. Built with Next.js and TypeScript, with Razorpay payments and AWS S3 storage.

projects.title: Beegains Academy
projects.description: A public website for a learning platform, paired with an admin dashboard so the team can manage its content in one place. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and MongoDB.

projects.title: Zenith Drugstore
projects.description: A B2B website for a UAE surgical and hospital-supplies distributor, presenting its product range clearly to clinics and hospitals. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

testimonials.name: Hadi Razal

testimonials.name: Jibin Jose

testimonials.name: Paul Gopurathingal
